summary.one_liner: A curated awesome-style list of tools, tutorials, theory essays, and example gardens for building a digital garden, a semi-public collection of evolving notes that sits between a blog and a wiki.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link collection rather than a software project. It is organized into sections: gardening tools split into public-garden builders (Roam, Obsidian, TiddlyWiki, Gatsby/Jekyll/Eleventy themes, Foam, Dendron, Quartz, and others) and private note tools (Bangle.io, Org Roam, TheBrain, The Archive), plus extras like Webmentions and Hypothesis. It also lists how-to tutorials, theory and philosophy essays on digital gardening, and related concepts such as Zettelkasten, wikis, and knowledge graphs. A final directory table lists people's personal digital gardens with their build tools and note themes, with some marked as featured. The README defines digital gardening and links to other compilations of gardens.
use_cases: Choosing a tool to publish personal notes as a website
Finding Jekyll, Gatsby, or Eleventy templates with backlinks
Learning how to turn a Roam Research graph into a public site
Reading background on digital gardens versus blogs
Browsing examples of other people's digital gardens
Setting up a private Zettelkasten-style note system
notable: Lists both public-publishing tools and private note-taking apps in one place
Includes a directory of real digital gardens with their build tools and note themes
Covers the theory and origin of digital gardening, including Mike Caulfield's essay
Links to Roam-to-site converters and tutorials for turning notes into a public garden
Points to other digital garden compilations for further browsing
caveats: This is a list of links, so the tools it names have their own platforms, setup needs, and licenses
Many entries are linked to third-party projects that may be outdated; the README does not say when it was last updated
Some tools named here, such as Roam Research and Notion, are closed or paid products; the README does not detail their pricing
